headline: Ratchet & Clank reaches 88.30% and begins measuring data separately
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 86.02% to 88.30%, with 4,595 of 5,109 functions reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The progress report now measures executable data separately, at 0.37%.
highlights: #76 finishes two stalled near misses and adapts three NTSC functions.
#79 adds three matches from retail code, including movie loading and image uploads, and fixes jump-table detection.
#78 counts compiled data separately from data still assembled from original dumps.
#80 publishes functional C coverage separately, with no matching credit.
